hooks.name: Prove on save

action.prompt:
Run this command in the terminal from the repo root:
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q -m "not oracle" tests/test_resurrect_billing.py tests/test_ghost_hunt.py

Then report in plain English, in at most 6 lines:
- how many tests passed and failed;
- if test_real_port_matches_every_golden_bill or test_no_float_and_no_builtin_round_in_the_port fails, start with "Ghost found", then give the smallest ghost (tariff, units, Oracle total, Python total) and the line of src/gravedigger/resurrected/billing.py that most likely caused it;
- if everything passes, say "No ghosts: the port matches all 2,006 Oracle bills".
Do not edit any file. Do not fix the code.

hooks.description: When the Python port is saved, hunt it against the 2,006 bills that real Oracle produced (golden/cases.json). No database needed. Reports any ghost: a bill where the port and the legacy PL/SQL disagree.
